title: AE daily outreach scratchpad - 2026-03-04
content:
Morning sprint notes (quick scratchpad)

Top priorities today:
- 9:30 AM call w/ RippleHealth (BDR -> intro). Goal: discover API use cases + get tech intro. Prep: send integration one-pager before call.
- 11:00 AM demo with KineticSoft (trial request). Focus: latency/cost questions + dedicated offering. Bring Redwood latency slide.
- Follow-ups: finish follow-up emails for leads from last week (see below list).

Call list (ordered by priority):
1) RippleHealth - John M. (VP Eng) - last: intro request. Call @9:30. Notes: care about PHI handling, private deployment. Ask about data residency and timeline.
2) KineticSoft - Priya S. - demo @11. Last: interested in dedicated GPUs. Confirm expected throughput.
3) NovaRetail - Carlos R. - left voicemail Tues. Try again 2:00 PM. Likely POC after pricing.
4) DataLyft - tech champion email thread; need to schedule architecture deep dive. Aim for Thurs.
5) Evergreen Logistics - inbound MQL; send qualification email + temp calendar link.

Follow-up email snippets (quick):
- RippleHealth: "Hey John — quick note ahead of our 9:30 call: attaching a one-pager on Redwood Private (PHI + KMS). If there are any specific compliance docs you want, flag them and I’ll bring on our security PM. — Avery"
- KineticSoft: "Thanks for scheduling — demo will cover latency/cost, model variants. Any specific prompts or scale expectations you want me to demo?"

Pipeline notes / next steps: 
- OPP-004321 (KineticSoft): move to demo stage, bring SRE for Q&A if they push on throughput.
- OPP-004215 (NovaRetail): send pricing estimator; include reserved capacity vs hosted comparison.

Personal TODOs (today):
- [x] Prep Redwood latency slide + bench numbers
- [ ] Draft RippleHealth one-pager (attach before 9:30)
- [ ] Send 3 follow-up emails (NovaRetail, DataLyft, Evergreen)
- [ ] Log call notes in SFDC after each meeting
- [ ] Update demo checklist with dedicated GPU questions

Random notes / reminders:
- If prospect asks about model rollback: mention rollouts + automatic fallback to smaller model to stay within SLOs.
- Ask about existing infra (on-prem vs cloud) early — shapes Private vs Dedicated convo.
- Quick win: highlight token-level cost breakdown in console screenshots during demo.
